title: Telling the Time
label: ch:time
canDo: I can ask for and tell the time in French.

payoff.summary: One noun, one frame and three small additions. heure is the same word as English hour, both from Latin hora and both keeping an h neither language ever said; il est ... heures counts the hours where English says o'clock; and midi and minuit are one idea used twice, the middle of the day and the middle of the night.
payoff.note: Chapter 8 is schema-v2 as of the handwritten-chapter retirement, so the payoff is atom-scored: FR-C08-practice assesses every atom the chapter introduces.
